description: Upstream, midstream, LNG, and refining equipment boundaries with explicit performance and composition inputs.

epa-petroleum-natural-gas-systems.title: EPA Greenhouse Gas Reporting Program: Petroleum and Natural Gas Systems
epa-petroleum-natural-gas-systems.license: U.S. Government work; verify page-specific third-party notices
epa-petroleum-natural-gas-systems.applicable_boundary: Industry-segment and equipment-source taxonomy from production through distribution
epa-petroleum-natural-gas-systems.note: The source supports boundary selection only. This pack supplies no site performance, composition, leak, or emission-factor defaults.

doe-netl-pipeline-compressor-field-tests.title: U.S. DOE NETL: Technologies to Enhance Operation of the Existing Natural Gas Compression Infrastructure
doe-netl-pipeline-compressor-field-tests.license: U.S. Government work; verify project-specific third-party notices
doe-netl-pipeline-compressor-field-tests.applicable_boundary: Observed compressor thermal efficiency for reciprocating natural-gas pipeline compressor units at two U.S. field sites
doe-netl-pipeline-compressor-field-tests.note: The reported range is equipment- and test-specific and does not represent all pipeline compressor technologies or operating points.

doe-industrial-pump-sourcebook.title: U.S. DOE Improving Pumping System Performance: A Sourcebook for Industry, Second Edition
doe-industrial-pump-sourcebook.license: U.S. Government work; verify sourcebook-specific third-party notices
doe-industrial-pump-sourcebook.applicable_boundary: Industrial centrifugal pump and electric motor input to useful hydraulic work
doe-industrial-pump-sourcebook.note: Pump efficiency is described as ranging from about 35% to above 90%; the sourcebook also uses 90% motor efficiency in screening examples. The derived pack envelope is deliberately broad.

doe-netl-natural-gas-hydrogen-pipeline-m.title: FECM/NETL Natural Gas with Hydrogen Pipeline Cost Model: Description and User's Manual
doe-netl-natural-gas-hydrogen-pipeline-m.license: U.S. Government work; verify report-specific third-party notices
doe-netl-natural-gas-hydrogen-pipeline-m.applicable_boundary: Natural-gas compressor shaft work to isentropic compression work, with a separately stated motor efficiency
doe-netl-natural-gas-hydrogen-pipeline-m.note: The model uses default compressor isentropic efficiency of 85% and motor efficiency of 96%. These are modeling assumptions, not measured fleet distributions.

lbnl-refinery-energy-guide.title: LBNL Energy Efficiency Improvement and Cost Saving Opportunities for Petroleum Refineries
lbnl-refinery-energy-guide.license: U.S. Government-sponsored public report; verify report notices
lbnl-refinery-energy-guide.applicable_boundary: Refinery process-heater fuel input to useful process heat on an HHV basis
lbnl-refinery-energy-guide.note: The guide reports refinery furnace efficiencies commonly estimated at 75%-90% and an approximately 92% theoretical maximum.

carrier.label: Raw natural gas
carrier.basis: caller-declared HHV or LHV and composition
carrier.boundary: Unprocessed gas at the selected facility boundary

carrier.label: Crude oil
carrier.basis: caller-declared assay and HHV or LHV
carrier.boundary: Crude oil at the selected production, transport, or refinery boundary

carrier.label: Liquefied natural gas
carrier.basis: caller-declared composition, pressure, temperature, and HHV or LHV
carrier.boundary: LNG at the selected liquefaction, storage, shipping, or regasification boundary

carrier.label: Minimum separation work
carrier.basis: reversible minimum work for the caller-declared feed and product compositions
carrier.boundary: Minimum reversible separation work only; not actual shaft or electrical consumption

technology.label: Electric submersible production pump
technology.boundary: Motor electrical terminals to hydraulic or shaft work; reservoir inflow and multiphase behavior remain external

efficiency.statistic: Midpoint of 35%-90% pump range multiplied by illustrative 90% motor efficiency
efficiency.range_basis: Products of published pump endpoints and illustrative motor efficiency

applicability.technology: Electric centrifugal pump handling predominantly liquid service
applicability.boundary: Motor electricity to hydraulic output; cable losses and multiphase degradation excluded

efficiency.note: Use only as a liquid-service fallback; gas fraction, downhole cable loss, wear, and off-BEP operation can invalidate it.

technology.label: Rod-lift surface drive
technology.boundary: Surface-drive electricity to declared mechanical lift work

technology.label: Water-injection pump
technology.boundary: Electrical input to hydraulic injection work

efficiency.statistic: Midpoint of 35%-90% pump range multiplied by illustrative 90% motor efficiency
efficiency.range_basis: Products of published pump endpoints and illustrative motor efficiency
efficiency.note: Use the actual pump and motor curves for design or field analysis.

technology.label: Gas-lift compressor
technology.boundary: Compressor shaft input to reversible gas-compression work; driver is separate

efficiency.statistic: NETL model default compressor isentropic efficiency
efficiency.range_basis: Published point assumption; not an uncertainty interval

applicability.technology: Natural-gas centrifugal compression used as a gas-lift proxy
applicability.boundary: Compressor shaft work to isentropic gas-compression work; driver excluded

efficiency.note: Gas-lift service may differ materially from a pipeline compressor; replace with a compressor map.

technology.label: Gathering and boosting compressor
technology.boundary: Compressor shaft input to reversible compression work

efficiency.statistic: NETL model default compressor isentropic efficiency
efficiency.range_basis: Published point assumption; not an uncertainty interval

applicability.boundary: Compressor shaft work to isentropic gas-compression work; driver excluded

efficiency.note: Gathering service composition, turndown, recycle, and liquid loading require a site compressor map.

technology.label: Natural-gas pipeline compressor
technology.boundary: Shaft work to reversible pipeline-gas compression work

efficiency.statistic: Midpoint of the reported observed compressor thermal-efficiency range
efficiency.range_basis: Observed 84-91% range in the cited reciprocating-compressor field tests; not a fleet distribution

applicability.technology: Reciprocating pipeline compressors represented by HBA-6 and TCVC10 field-test units
applicability.boundary: Compressor shaft input to reversible/thermal compression work as reported by the NETL project
applicability.geography: Two United States natural-gas pipeline compressor stations

efficiency.note: Do not transfer this prior to centrifugal compressors, drivers, or complete compressor packages without changing the boundary.

technology.label: Gas-reinjection compressor
technology.boundary: Shaft work to reversible reinjection compression work

efficiency.statistic: NETL model default compressor isentropic efficiency
efficiency.range_basis: Published point assumption; not an uncertainty interval

applicability.technology: Natural-gas centrifugal compressor used as a reinjection proxy
applicability.boundary: Compressor shaft work to isentropic compression work; driver and intercooling excluded

efficiency.note: High pressure ratio and staging make a site model especially important.

technology.label: Amine gas-sweetening auxiliaries
technology.boundary: Selected electrical auxiliaries to minimum separation work; reboiler heat must be modeled as a separate input

technology.label: Glycol gas-dehydration auxiliaries
technology.boundary: Selected electrical auxiliaries to minimum water-removal work; regeneration heat is separate

technology.label: Cryogenic NGL-recovery auxiliaries
technology.boundary: Selected electrical input to minimum separation work; refrigeration and expander work require explicit connected flows

technology.label: LNG liquefaction train
technology.boundary: Declared liquefaction-train electrical input to minimum liquefaction work; fuel drivers and feed pretreatment are separate

technology.label: LNG regasification pump
technology.boundary: Electrical input to LNG pumping work; vaporization heat is separate

efficiency.statistic: Midpoint of 35%-90% pump range multiplied by illustrative 90% motor efficiency
efficiency.range_basis: Products of published pump endpoints and illustrative motor efficiency

applicability.technology: Electric centrifugal liquid pump used only as a first-pass proxy for LNG service
applicability.boundary: Motor electricity to hydraulic work; cryogenic property effects and vaporization excluded

efficiency.note: A cryogenic manufacturer curve should replace this generic pump-family prior.

technology.label: Vapor-recovery compressor
technology.boundary: Electrical input to recovered-vapor compression work; avoided emissions require measured capture and disposition data

efficiency.statistic: Product of NETL default 85% compressor and 96% motor efficiencies
efficiency.range_basis: Derived point assumption; not an uncertainty interval

applicability.technology: Electric motor-driven natural-gas compressor used as a vapor-recovery proxy
applicability.boundary: Motor electrical input to isentropic compression work

efficiency.note: No methane capture rate or avoided-emissions claim is inferred.

technology.label: Flare-gas recovery compressor
technology.boundary: Electrical input to recovered-gas compression; flare destruction, slip, and avoided emissions remain separate inventories

efficiency.statistic: Product of NETL default 85% compressor and 96% motor efficiencies
efficiency.range_basis: Derived point assumption; not an uncertainty interval

applicability.technology: Electric motor-driven natural-gas compressor used as a flare-gas-recovery proxy
applicability.boundary: Motor electrical input to isentropic compression work

efficiency.note: Flare capture, destruction, methane slip, and recovered-gas disposition remain separate measured inventories.

technology.label: Refinery charge pump
technology.boundary: Electrical terminals to liquid pumping work

efficiency.statistic: Midpoint of 35%-90% pump range multiplied by illustrative 90% motor efficiency
efficiency.range_basis: Products of published pump endpoints and illustrative motor efficiency
efficiency.note: Use actual crude properties, pump curve, motor curve, and operating point when available.

technology.label: Crude-distillation furnace
technology.boundary: Selected furnace fuel input to crude-feed heat; distillation separation and utilities are separate

efficiency.statistic: Midpoint of the reported refinery-furnace efficiency range

applicability.boundary: Fuel HHV to useful crude-feed heat; downstream separation and utilities excluded
applicability.vintage: Report based on then-current refinery practice

efficiency.note: Verify HHV basis and calculate from measured fuel and absorbed duty when possible.

technology.label: Hydrotreater charge heater
technology.boundary: Selected heater fuel input to process heat; reaction hydrogen and compression are separate

efficiency.statistic: Midpoint of the reported refinery-furnace efficiency range

applicability.boundary: Fuel HHV to useful charge heat; hydrogen reaction and compression excluded
applicability.vintage: Report based on then-current refinery practice

efficiency.note: Verify HHV basis and calculate from measured fuel and absorbed duty when possible.

technology.label: Steam-methane reformer furnace
technology.boundary: Furnace fuel input to reformer process heat; methane feed, reaction products, and capture are separate material and system flows

efficiency.statistic: Midpoint of the reported refinery-furnace efficiency range
efficiency.range_basis: Published 75%-90% refinery furnace range used as a fired-heater proxy

applicability.technology: Steam-methane-reformer fired heater used within a petroleum-refinery context
applicability.boundary: Furnace fuel HHV to absorbed reformer process heat; methane feed chemistry and heat recovery outside
applicability.vintage: Report based on then-current refinery practice

efficiency.note: This is furnace efficiency only, not hydrogen-production efficiency or carbon-capture performance.

material_templates.label: Oil-gas-water production separator balance
material_templates.boundary: Wellstream feed to oil, gas, produced-water, solids, vent, flare, drain, and inventory streams

material_templates.label: Natural-gas processing material balance
material_templates.boundary: Field gas, fuel and additives to pipeline gas, NGL products, acid gas, water, vent, flare, and inventory streams

material_templates.label: LNG liquefaction material balance
material_templates.boundary: Feed gas and refrigerant makeup to LNG, boil-off, fuel gas, removed contaminants, vents, flares, and inventory change

material_templates.label: Crude-distillation material balance
material_templates.boundary: Crude and additives to gas, naphtha, distillate, gas oil, residue, sour water, off-gas, slop, and inventory change

material_templates.label: Refinery hydrogen-system material balance
material_templates.boundary: Hydrogen production, purchases, recycle, consumers, purge, fuel, vent, flare, and inventory streams

material_templates.label: Flare, vent, and recovery material reconciliation
material_templates.boundary: Measured flare-header and vent feeds to recovered gas, combusted products, methane slip, uncombusted vent, and inventory change

material_templates.label: Produced-water system material balance
material_templates.boundary: Produced water and treatment additions to reinjection, discharge, recovered hydrocarbons, solids, vapor, and inventory change

metadata.default_policy: selected published F1 priors; explicit performance, composition, pressure, and measured inventory preferred
metadata.methane_note: Use assess_methane_project for vent, flare, oxidation, and recovery comparisons.
